title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2611.18639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. translated_title: SynthDCB：面向可扩展设备控制基准测试的世界蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 扩展设备控制评估需要同时扩展智能体所交互的世界以及它们需要解决的任务。我们提出了SynthDCB，一个通过世界蒸馏构建的、可扩展的环境感知与设备控制基准。世界蒸馏将设备行为、交互约束和环境效应的知识转化为模块化的可执行组件，这些组件被组合成具有显式状态、动作和时间动态的交互式世界。统一的能力表示将工具发现、世界执行和任务合成连接起来，使新的能力能够通过共享的构建流水线进入评估。SynthDCB实例化了家居、汽车和手机三个领域，包含114个设备类别、1,166个功能和95个事件，支持五大任务族共32个子类型。这种有状态的设计支持通过状态正确性和工具调用轨迹进行任务验证与智能体评估。我们评估了……
tldr: 该论文提出SynthDCB基准，创新性地通过“世界蒸馏”方法将设备行为知识转化为模块化可执行组件，构建了覆盖家居、汽车和手机三大领域的可扩展设备控制与环境感知评测基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control that leverages "world distillation" to convert device behavior knowledge into modular executable components, spanning Home, Car, and Phone domains.
